items.title: Docker
items.description: I'm learning it to run applications in the same environment anywhere — so the "it works on my machine" problem stops happening.

items.title: Git
items.description: The tool I use every day to track code changes and push them to GitHub.

items.title: XAMPP
items.description: A local server bundle with Apache, PHP, and MySQL. I use it to run PHP projects on my own machine before uploading them to hosting.

items.title: Laragon
items.description: A lighter, faster alternative to XAMPP. I use it to run Laravel locally.

items.title: Pentaho
items.description: A tool for processing and moving data between sources — taking data from one database, cleaning it up, and storing it somewhere else.
